args.body: Take EXPLICIT-INQUIRY-ATTRIBUTION as a bounded measurement improvement. The observed gap is three unclassified sources, not proven absence of requests. Reuse the existing routing work; establish that identifiers are supported before editing. Prepare only changes that improve future attribution, with synthetic link verification and independent exact-digest review. Do not promise retroactive classification, responder integration or actual acquisition. Leave the CSV, Shopify and welfare observation deadlines unchanged; collection remains a separate dependency.

description: Feedback is available but contains three unclassified sources and no classified commercial events; demand and attribution remain unknown. Test whether explicit experiment identifiers can make future voluntary inquiries attributable. Missing payment collection blocks paid acceptance, not this bounded improvement. Preserve existing observation deadlines and public review gates.
